title: Bank Transfer Payment Processing
desc:
I’m building “Eren Money”, a dedicated payment-processing platform focused exclusively on moving funds by bank transfer. I already have the business logic mapped out; what I need now is a seasoned software developer (or small team) to turn that blueprint into a production-ready application.

Here’s what success looks like:

• A secure, well-documented code-base (language and stack are flexible) that can initiate, track, and reconcile domestic and international bank transfers through common banking rails (ACH, SEPA, SWIFT or equivalent).  
• An API layer that merchants can consume to create transactions, query status, and receive webhooks for updates.  
• A lightweight web dashboard for both end-users and an internal admin, including KYC/AML checks, transaction history, and basic reporting.  
• Comprehensive automated tests and a short deployment guide so I can spin up staging/production environments quickly.

I’m most concerned with reliability, clear error handling, and audit-ready logging, so please highlight any previous work with financial or fintech integrations when you reply. If you also have ideas for adding card or crypto handling later, let me know—we may expand once the core bank-transfer flow is solid.

• Breakthroughs in humanoid and industrial robotics, autonomy stacks, spatial computing interfaces and real-world deployment case studies

Acceptance criteria
• 100% original analysis with citations to reputable sources and up-to-date market data (Q2 2024 or newer)  
• Executive-level narrative first, then supporting charts/tables (Excel or Google Sheets preferred)

• Turnaround: first full draft within three days of hire; final versio

desc:

The system should read each question, evaluate the provided options, and select the most probable correct answer without human intervention. My main interest is the automation of the quiz-taking process itself, not the generation of new questions.

If you have built similar bots, scripts, or machine-learning models for assessment platforms, please let me know how your past experience aligns with this task. I’m open to the underlying technology—Python with Selenium or Playwright, headless browser automations, or a custom model—so long as it consistently submits accurate answers and can be adapted to different quiz interfaces.

Key deliverable: a working, documented solution I can deploy locally or on a cloud VM, along with simple instructions to retrain or tweak it for future quizzes.

title: Podcast Transcripts with Timestamped Entries
desc:
I have several podcast episodes that need to be turned into clean, accurate transcripts and then logged for future reference. Here is exactly what I’m after:

• Each episode transcribed in a single Word document (.docx).  
• A timestamp inserted every time the speaker changes—but no need to label who is talking; I just want the content itself. For example:  
  [00:04:12] I really like the new feature...  
• No additional speaker identification, headings, or formatting beyond clear paragraphs and the required timestamps.  
• Spelling and punctuation should read naturally, omitting false starts and filler words unless they affect meaning.

Once a transcript is completed, simply record the file name and episode title in a small tracking sheet (Excel or Google Sheets is fine) so I can keep an eye on progress.

I’ll supply the audio links as soon as we start. Let me know your usual turnaround time per hour of audio and any questions you might have so we can get rolling right away.

title: English-Somali Business Correspondence Translation
desc:
I have several pieces of general business correspondence written in English that need to be translated into clear, professional Somali. These are everyday business emails and letters—nothing highly technical or legal, but they still require absolute accuracy in tone, intent, and formatting so my Somali-speaking partners can read and respond without confusion.

What I will send you: Word or PDF files containing the original messages.  
What I expect back: fully translated Somali versions in the same file format, laid out exactly as the originals (headers, signatures, bullet points, dates, and any company references must stay consistent).

Because these documents facilitate ongoing business communication, the language must sound natural to native Somali readers while preserving every nuance of the original English. If you prefer to use a CAT tool such as Trados or memoQ to keep terminology consistent, that is perfectly fine, but the final submission has to be polished, human-readable Somali.

Acceptance criteria  
• Complete, error-free Somali text that mirrors the meaning and structure of the source.  
• No machine-translation artifacts.  
• Delivery of each translated file within the agreed timeline.

If you are fluent in both English and Somali and have experience translating day-to-day business correspondence, I look forward to working with you.

title: Creative Long-Form Video Edit -- 2
desc:
I will hand over a folder filled with raw clips, photos, my logo, the voice-over track, and the script. Your job is to transform that material into a polished story that runs comfortably over five minutes. 

I’m looking for a distinctly creative and artistic style—bold pacing, inventive transitions, eye-catching motion graphics, and typography that feels part of the narrative rather than an overlay. I don’t have a reference video, so I’m relying on you to suggest concepts or previous work that can steer the visual direction.

The edit should:
• Trim out stumbles, dead air, and anything that slows the flow  
• Layer in tasteful zooms, whip-pans, match-cuts, and B-roll to keep viewers engaged  
• Add titles, lower thirds, and full subtitles, delivered as an .srt as well as burned-in captions  
• Clean up dialogue, balance music and FX, and craft a light but cinematic color grade

I work comfortably with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve project files, so please keep your timeline organized for easy hand-off.  

Deliverables  
1. First rough cut for feedback (H.264, 1080p or higher)  
2. Final master in the agreed format plus a vertical teaser cut if practical  
3. Separate subtitle file  
4. All editable project files and assets upon approval  

Meet those points, keep the energy fresh, and hit the schedule we agree on, and we’ll be golden. I’m excited to see what you come up with.

title: Client IAM Policy Editor
desc:
I’m planning to roll out a small-footprint Identity and Access Management editor that my clients can use to create, view, and adjust their own policies without touching the underlying infrastructure. At its core the tool should let an administrator sign in, browse existing users and groups, and then add, change, or revoke permissions through an intuitive interface.  

Although I have not finalised the target environment yet, I want the architecture to stay flexible enough to plug into common cloud stacks such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud later on. If you already have presets or libraries that handle role definitions, access-control statements, or audit logs for any of those platforms, feel free to mention them in your approach.  

The deliverable I’m looking for is a working web-based editor—clean UX, clear separation between data and presentation, and secure API endpoints ready for integration into a broader admin portal. Please outline:  
• Your preferred tech stack (front-end, back-end, database or policy store)  
• How you will keep policy updates atomic and auditable  
• Any prior work you’ve done with IAM schemas or permission editors  

I’ll review prototypes quickly, so short iterations or milestone demos are welcome.

desc:

2. At least two weeks of ready-to-publish social posts (images or short-form video ideas + captions) aligned with the strategy.

Acceptance Criteria

title: Overseas Plastic Part Production
desc:
My injection-molded plastic part—with two small metal inserts—has already been proven through a working prototype and the design is fully locked. I do not have any drawings. Now I want to move straight into creating a mold along with production and I’d like to base the operation with a reliable overseas factory.

Your role is to take the product from “ready for production” to the first pallet on the water. You will need to reverse engineer this part. You help me refine for manufacturability where needed, locate and vet suitable molders, coordinate tooling, inserts, over-moulding or post-assembly, set up quality control and organize logistics.

Key deliverables  
• Three or more vetted factory quotations, each detailing tooling cost, piece-part pricing at several volume tiers and lead times  
• DFM feedback incorporated into updated CAD and a short report outlining any trade-offs made  
• Pre-production T1 samples shipped to me, accompanied by dimensional and cosmetic inspection data  
• A concise production plan that covers tooling kick-off, pilot run, QC checkpoints, packaging and shipping arrangements

Acceptance criteria  
• Factory contacts are verifiable and willing to communicate directly  
• Quoted costs and timelines are realistic and match the plan you provide  
• T1 samples match the approved CAD within tolerance and include the metal inserts securely integrated

Timeline is flexible but I’d like to place the tooling order as soon as we lock a supplier.

title: Cross-Platform Non-Custodial Crypto Wallet
desc:
I’m ready to build a production-grade, non-custodial crypto wallet that runs smoothly on iOS and Android. Private keys must never leave the user’s device, and the experience needs to feel as simple as any mainstream payments app.

Core feature set  
• Send and receive cryptocurrencies with QR scanning and shareable wallet addresses  
• Real-time and historical transaction list with clear status indicators  
• Multi-currency support from day one (Bitcoin, Ethereum/ERC-20 preferred) and an architecture that lets us add new assets quickly  

Security and recovery  
• Biometric authentication (Face ID / Touch ID / Android Biometrics)  
• Optional two-factor authentication before approving a transaction  
• Passphrase backup that users can export, verify, and import at any time  

Under the hood I expect:  
– BIP-39/44 HD wallet generation, AES-256 encryption for key storage, and a zero-knowledge approach so no sensitive data ever touches my servers.  
– A clean, well-documented codebase—React Native, Flutter, or native (Swift + Kotlin) are all fine as long as the result is performant and maintainable.  
– Unit tests and basic CI so new coins or features can ship with confidence.  
– Signed builds ready for TestFlight and Google Play internal testing, plus hand-off docs that let my team publish future updates on our own.

When you reply, outline how you’ll tackle key management, multi-chain integration, and security auditing, along with a realistic timeline for an MVP and public s

title: Replicate PDF Layout in Excel
desc:
I have a PDF document that must look and feel identical once it lives in Excel. Every column width, row height, font style, border, and color should mirror the source so that a quick side-by-side comparison shows no visual difference. I do not need formulas—this is purely about presentation—but I do need the file to remain editable afterward.  

Please bring in only those images that add meaning to the sheet and discard the decorative ones; if an image clarifies data or serves as a header or logo, keep it in the same position and scale. All pages and sections deserve the same level of care, so work through the PDF sequentially instead of prioritizing any single area.

Deliverable:
• One Excel workbook (.xlsx) that faithfully reproduces the entire PDF layout, with relevant images embedded and aligned.

I’ll review by overlaying the PDF on top of the Excel print preview; approval comes once the two are indistinguishable. Let me know your estimated turnaround and any questions before you begin.

title: Hindi Content Writers for Gaming Website
desc:
Project Description for Content Writer:

Project Overview:
I need 3 high-quality articles in Hindi for my gaming information website (allyonogamepoints.com). My website was recently hit by a Google manual spam action due to low-quality/thin content. I need 100% human-written, informative, and deeply researched articles to clear the penalty and get re-indexed in Google search.

Core Rules (Strictly Follow):
1. Language: Simple, easy-to-read Hindi (हिंदी). Headings can be in Hinglish/English for SEO purposes.
2. No AI Content: Zero use of ChatGPT or AI tools. The text must pass all AI detectors and plagiarism checkers.
3. No Keyword Stuffing: Do not repeat app names (like Yono, Rummy, Teen Patti) forcefully. Write naturally for real human readers.
4. Length: Each article must be between 1200 to 1500 words.
5. No Direct Download Promos: Focus on information, rules, and safety guide rather than just saying "Download this app".

---

Article Topics & Outlines to Write:

Topic 1: Online Rummy और Card Games खेलने के नियम और जीतने की सही स्ट्रेटेजी 
Key Headings to include:
- Online Rummy क्या है और यह भारत में कितनी लोकप्रिय है?
- रम्मी गेम के बेसिक नियम (Rules) जो हर खिलाड़ी को पता होने चाहिए।
- कार्ड्स को अरेंज (Sequence and Sets) करने का सही तरीका।
- रम्मी खेलते समय कौन सी गलतियों से बचना चाहिए?
- Responsible Gaming: गेमिंग की लत से कैसे बचें और सुरक्षित रहें?

Topic 2: New Mobile Gaming Apps डाउनलोड करते समय फ्रॉड और स्कैम से कैसे बचें?
Key Headings to include:
- इंटरनेट पर मौजू

title: Social Media and Paid Ads Specialist
desc:
Description:

We are SABloan (ABFin Advisory Pvt Ltd) — a loan distribution business (DSA) working with public sector banks, private banks and NBFCs across Rajasthan, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra. We offer car loans new and used car loans. 

We’re looking for one person to own our social media + paid ads and deliver qualified loan enquiries, not vanity metrics. 
Scope of work

	•	Manage Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and Google Business Profile (@teamsabloan)
	•	Plan and produce a monthly content calendar — static creatives, carousels and short-form Reels in Hinglish, targeted at Tier-2/3 city audiences
	•	Run and optimise Meta and Google lead-gen campaigns end to end: audiences, creatives, A/B tests, budget pacing
	•	Route leads into our CRM / WhatsApp and report weekly on spend, CPL and lead quality
	•	Community management: comments, DMs, review responses

Must-haves

	•	Proven paid-ads experience in BFSI / lending / insurance in India (please share case studies with actual CPL and lead volume numbers)
	•	Working knowledge of Meta’s Financial Products & Services advertising policy and RBI’s advertising norms for lending intermediaries. Our creatives must never use words like “guaranteed”, “instant approval” or “lowest rate”, and must carry DSA/partner-bank disclosures. Compliance is non-negotiable — a policy strike costs us far more than any campaign gains
	•	Fluent Hindi + English; able to write natural Hinglish copy
	•	Hands-on with Meta Business Manage

title: Translate App Help to Kannada
desc:
I need the Help and instruction sections for my mobile application translated accurately into Kannada. All source material is already collated in standard Word and PDF files, so you can work directly in those formats and preserve the existing layout, headings, and any embedded screenshots or code snippets.  

The focus is solely on this Help/Instructions content—I am not translating the user-interface strings or push notifications right now—so you can concentrate on clear, easy-to-follow explanatory language that matches the tone of the original English text.  

Deliverables  
• A fully translated Kannada version of each Word/PDF file, keeping original formatting intact.  
• A brief note highlighting any phrases that required contextual clarification so I can review them inside the app.  

I’ll review the work for fluency, completeness, and fidelity to the source. Once approved, we can discuss future batches if you’re interested.
